note: OFFLINE replay map: which dataset of a beamline-written alignment HDF5 file sets which SIMULATOR control. By device NAME (the file's own group names and NDAttrSource PVs); this is NOT the live-PV map (control_pv_map.json, which stays unverified): no scale/offset is learned here, every entry is scale 1 / offset 0 and the sign/zero questions below stay open. Controls with no entry are left at the simulator default and listed in `not_mapped`.

rotation.note: the file's NDAttrSource; the same PV BLADE lists for samE.ry. The HL group's samRy (1ide1:m4) is a different stage (constant 15 deg here).

controls.note: sim and panel coordinates may differ by an offset (control_pv_map.json samE.x); used as is
same caveat; this is the pin height of the mount
labelled RotX in the file; control_pv_map.json lists 1ide1:m101 as samE.aerox

not_mapped.tomoE.x / tomoE.y (GH1 stage 1ide1:m63 /: not recorded in the file (the DMS group lists 1idc:m77/m79/m84 = hutch C camera stage). The camera position is a free fit parameter (it sets where the footprint lands in the ROI).
not_mapped.E lens stacks 1-4 (instrument/BCS/E/LENS: recorded, but the simulator's lens controls (x in/out, y, th, phi) have a different meaning; the frames show a plain slit-defined box (no lens collapse), so the lenses are treated as not acting (parked in the simulator). Assumption, see verify.json.
not_mapped.slit zeros: the file gives each slit's centre READBACK; the hidden zero between that coordinate and the lab beam axis cannot be identified per slit. Offline replay assumption (blade.calibration.pin_frames_fit.sim_world): every slit opening is centred on the beam (truth zero = beam centre - readback). Only the footprint-defining upstream E slit matters for these frames.
not_mapped.slit centre sign: the simulator's hsign (+hcenter moves the opening to +u) is an open question of the twin; centres are passed through unchanged.
not_mapped.ROI: the frames are a 1940 x 1490 ROI at offset (585, 475) of the sensor; the simulator camera is that ROI.
